decisions.reason: The spectral theorem F1 and support lemma F3 require nonzero Hilbert spaces. Added a direct zero-space branch: both domains, adjoints, PVMs and integrals are zero, both spectra are empty by the resolvent definition, and unit-vector laws are vacuous. The remaining proof explicitly assumes nonzero spaces; the Statement is unchanged.

The number operator is dimensionless and n denotes the excitation count, so the declared reciprocal-count label is misleading even though count was declared dimensionless. Replaced it consistently with unit 1 in Definition, scope and Remarks. Domains, spectra, dynamics and adopted model assumptions are unchanged; consumer unit restatements are inventoried for their owners.

Clause (d) used coherent dynamics without an actual evolution supplier. Declared the earlier purely mathematical coherent-evolution-and-variance theorem and cited its exact clauses (c), (e), (f), whose proof supplies the spectral phase rotation and closed-domain Q/P means. Explicit scaled mean coordinates clarify rotation; unit 1 matches the repaired model. No later physics consumer is used as a premise, so no cycle is introduced.

The P7 status reference lacked an explicit formulation dependency; added P7 and F9 solely for the qualified laboratory-comparison status. Independently confirmed the digest fatal defect: a core is a graph-norm-dense linear subspace, whereas the basis family is not a subspace and stays at distance at least sqrt(2-sqrt(2)) from (psi_0+psi_1)/sqrt(2). Corrected Statement (a) and step 2.1 to the algebraic span, exactly as scaling clause (c) proves; eigenvalues, eigenspaces and outcome laws are preserved. Number units now agree with the model.

The adopted model clause (a) and the cited spectrum theorem already carry AC, so the outcome-law deduction is not choice-free and its formulas are sound. However the example names only Countable Choice and omits the schema-required explicit AC dependency. Added AC to the Example assumptions, Given and deps/roles; no stronger mathematical assumption than the adopted model is introduced. Unit 1 synchronizes the number-observable restatements; ladder norms and atomic laws remain unchanged.

The P7 description is faithful to the preparation-and-apparatus postulate and concerns empirical identification, not the conditional oscillator prediction. Added its direct formulation dependency and F8, used only in status step 4.1. The spectral-phase evolution, all-label Q/P means, constant spreads, normalized Poisson weights and variance s=|z|^2 (including z=0) remain sound. Unit 1 aligns scope and number-mean restatements with the repaired model; no observation or statistical precision is claimed.
